title: Shiraishi An — Have No Regrets〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, that was so awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you for showing us this video of Akito and the others competing in Shinobi Battle, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, why'd you show them the archived version of the MORE MORE JUMP! stream? There is an official video.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because Minori and the others are cheering in this one! They made things way more fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree! You could tell how excited they were about their friend competing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wish I could've been there that day, but cheering them on with all of you today was very fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I also had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And it wasn't just those idols.
Everyone else there was also cheering like crazy!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I thought I heard your voice while that Haruka girl was jumping between those poles, An...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, was that you who shouted, “Fly!”?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you guys heard that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You really startled us since we were standing right next to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Go, Haruka!
Swing and fly!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Help me out, Akito, Tenma!
She'll succeed if we give her enough support!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
“She'll succeed if we give her enough support!”
That's so beautiful♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's just the way Haruka's brain works.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, does that mean you shouted, “If you give up now, then you'll regret it for the rest of your life!” for the same reason? Because you two have known each other forever?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup!
Actually, we experienced something similar in the past.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something similar?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, during elementary school.
Back then, Haruka and I were both friends and rivals.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We were having a footrace in the park after school that day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The first person to touch the tree there would win, but I tripped a few steps in front of it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka saw me fall, but she touched the tree before coming to help me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She asked me if I was okay and tried to help me up, and I said thanks and got to my feet...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She had a really troubled look on her face.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Troubled? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Was it because she went to touch the tree before going over to help you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But they were having a race.
Not only that, the finish line was right there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly. I felt the same way as you two, Rin, Len. I wasn't actually bothered at all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Haruka was.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We had another race a few months later, but I tripped again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Guess what Haruka did? She stopped so fast I thought she might trip herself, and rushed right over.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I think anyone would be surprised.
So, without even thinking, I said...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School An
rows.Line:
Why'd you come over to help me?
You should've touched the tree.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Haruka
rows.Line: No, I didn't want to.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Haruka
rows.Line: After what happened last time, I decided to never leave you behind like that ever again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Powerful words. Her will must be ironclad.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, this happened when you two were still in elementary school?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Pretty amazing, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka isn't really one to beat around the bush, but she does let certain feelings get pent up inside of her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I didn't realize just how much she regretted winning that race instead of helping me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, there was a next time and she got a chance to clear her conscience, and she seemed to feel much better after that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But she probably isn't going to find herself in another Shinobi Battle sort of situation for a long time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, good point!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's exactly why I absolutely didn't want her to feel any regrets.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seem to know quite a lot about Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course I do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She's my best friend, after all!
